utc_temporal_window.description: The classification logic derives the temporal window at runtime from the target execucao record (com_execucoes_sincronizacao id=62otoics23ul0vy) fields 'inicio' (window start) and 'fim' (window end). These are UTC date strings read server-side. A record's 'created' field is classified as within-window if created >= inicio AND created <= fim. No execution was performed in this task, so the exact runtime values are not materialized here.

classification_rules.DIAGNOSTIC_OWNED: execucao_id matches target AND origin matches diagnostic transport (activecampaign) AND created within execution window (inicio..fim) AND tipo/severidade/descricao consistent with diagnostic
classification_rules.PREEXISTENT: created before diagnostic window OR belongs to different origin
classification_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: diagnostic ownership cannot be proven — NEVER presumed deletable
inconclusive_triggers_literal: generic tipo or descricao (not consistent with diagnostic patterns)
missing or out-of-window timestamp (created outside inicio..fim)
any divergent evidence that prevents proving all four DIAGNOSTIC_OWNED conditions simultaneously

protection_confirmation.protection_rule: Only DIAGNOSTIC_OWNED records may be considered for future compensation. PREEXISTENT and INCONCLUSIVE are expressly protected and non-deletable.
